outlineData.note: Geographic outline data for the globe. Generated by scripts/globe/build_overlay.py from the workspace's boundary layer; kept in data/generated/ (server only), never in public/, and served only by the /geo/globe-boundaries.json route after it matches this record. Not a download: nothing here contacts a network.

derivedFrom.note: The workspace's layer, served unchanged at /geo/boundaries.json. Its own provenance (3 Overpass snapshot times and the SHA-256 of each of the 26 raw response files) is in that file's meta.snapshots and meta.rawSha256.

outlineData.source: OpenStreetMap via the public Overpass API (admin_level 5 and 6 boundary relations)
outlineData.status: Provisional. Outlines are unofficial and not an authoritative depiction. Block links are by exact name within the official district and have not been reviewed. Legal review of ODbL use is not recorded.
